name: PCI DSS, requirement 6 and 8.6.2
note: PCI DSS does not list weaknesses by CWE, so each requirement is assessed by the kind of scan that evidences it. A requirement is 'assessed' when such a scan ran in the last 30 days.

controls.name: Bespoke and custom software is reviewed before release to find coding vulnerabilities
Software engineering techniques prevent or mitigate common software attacks
Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed
System components are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing security patches
Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks
Passwords for application and system accounts are not hard coded in scripts, configuration files or source code
